answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the lantern forfeiture exposes up in the canyon totals with the meadow audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 33% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 163 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
